turn: I added lease renewal to the bucket cache. In `src/bucketcache/renew.go`, `Lease.Renew` now asks the shared bucket for a new batch of `LeaseSize` (10) tokens whenever the local tokens run out. It stores the number actually granted in `l.Left`, so a partial grant is respected. I haven't run the test suite or a build for this change. The only check was reading the function against the `take` callback's signature, so it is untested. In the same commit I made one small unplanned fix. A log line in the cache's key-formatting helper printed the wrong variable, and it now prints the bucket key. Next I'll start on "Cache invalidation on policy update".

sidefix.title: Fix wrong variable in log line
sidefix.what: A log line in the cache's key-formatting helper printed the wrong variable, so it now prints the bucket key.
